primary.command_contract: Explicit argv only. Private selected-project cwd; use ARANY_TOOL_WORKSPACE, ARANY_TOOL_INPUTS and ARANY_TOOL_SKILLS for paths inside shell strings. Standalone /workspace, /scratch, /inputs, /skills and /programs argv paths map to private native paths; checked system programs execute at their original paths. No network, host home, credentials or state. Bounded regular-file changes return as a changeset; a separate applied integration receipt confirms Workspace publication. command_unguarded re-runs an identical failed command on the host only after the user approves it.
primary.file_tools: list (directory entries), read (UTF-8, nullable 1-based line offset, nullable limit 1..2000, numbered lines, whole-file sha256), search (literal or regex lines in a file or directory, include glob, case control, up to 100 rows per page with next_offset; use Read or a file include for edit sha256), mkdir (new directory; parent must exist), write (null digest only creates), edit (unique literal match, expected sha256)
